claims.statement: Foreigners fight in Thailand; the gym or trainer arranges the bout.
Bouts run up to 5 rounds of 3 minutes with 2-minute rests; elbows are legal.
Weight classes follow the WMC list and the same names cover different weights across promotions.
claims.allowed_wording: kg uniquement quand la source les donne.

claims.statement: A beginner purse is about 3,000-5,000 THB per fight, split 50/50 with the gym.
claims.limits: Low, anecdote ; jamais un tarif Wildcat.

claims.statement: Preparation takes 3-4 weeks minimum, or 2-3 months for someone who has never competed, at the camps cited.
A ringside physician examines fighters before weigh-in and after the bout; rest is mandatory (7, 14, 21 days, 30 after a KO loss).
Many travel insurance policies exclude combat sports or bouts.
claims.limits: Low ; ne pas nommer d'assureur sans source verifiee.

claims.statement: Paid fighting and visa status: sources conflict (grey area vs Non-B plus work permit).
claims.allowed_wording: Presenter les deux positions, renvoyer ambassade/avocat.
claims.limits: Aucune source officielle ; ne pas trancher.

claims.statement: The DTV covers Muay Thai training with an enrolment letter and 500,000 THB funds; 180 days per entry.
Wildcat Fight Team offers fight prep, clinch and sparring with our coaches, plus corner support on fight night; Fighter program is 7,000 THB per month (twice a day).
claims.allowed_wording: Reprendre la phrase du site telle quelle.
claims.limits: Rien de plus sur matchmaking, frais, frequence, assurance.

claims.statement: Wildcat guests have fought at Thapae, Kalare and Loi Kroh stadiums in Chiang Mai (fighters guest book).
claims.limits: Pas de record W/L ni de partenariat.

claims.statement: Wildcat sets match frequency, matchmaking rules, fees, insurance, minimum level or partner stadiums beyond the guest book.
claims.allowed_wording: Ne pas affirmer ; a demander a Meaw.
claims.limits: Voir section 'Ne pas affirmer' du brief.
